about: Decides how much motion each beat gets, so the film spends almost nothing nearly everywhere and everything in one or two places.

provides.briefing: Allocate the beat plan's motion budget the way a TV anime allocates drawings: most shots held, a handful given everything. Run scripts/framebudget.py against beat-plan.json, then open the result and move the sakuga cut to the moment that earns it -- the distribution is mechanical, the choice of peak is not. The plan is style-neutral; the production designer passes it to the style at compile.
